summary: Verdict: safe and mildly positive, but low-yield. Rewrites: 21 of 56 accepted improved, 31 neutral, 4 harmful (7%), and none added slop. Autofixes: 12 of 35 improved, 16 neutral, 7 worse; 5 of the 7 are 'Applies to: X. Every future ...' fragments from dash-gloss. All 4 rejections were correct. Worst: cli-w dropped 'since' and broke grammar, b-fw-role turned an appositive into a list with commas, b-dc-role's 'includes' made a scope list partial, and full-management-17 buried an instruction under a false lead. Pattern: the 3-sentence list-item cap rejects Luna's clean splits, so Sol falls back to dash-to-colon swaps and 13 one-item sub-bullets. Fix before a full pass: a comma for noun-phrase glosses in dash-gloss, parentheses for paired dashes, and connector words (since, while, because) in meaning-words.
keyConvention: Rewrite keys are <pagePath>#<blockId>. Autofix keys add '~autofix', because 7 blocks have both an autofix and a rewrite. Every label also carries kind.

pageConcerns.note: Dash-gloss autofix leaves 3 'Applies to' fragments (firewall-a, fw-a, ext-a), a double colon in roster-model, and 'every run runs' in enf-d. Seven accepted rewrites end in a one-item sub-bullet where a period would keep the item flat. cli-w passed fact-check at P 0.30 (limit 0.35) yet dropped 'since' and broke grammar. walls-d and firewall-d were rejected twice and still need a person.

No harm in 9 accepted rewrites, but 7 are dash or semicolon swaps on short sentences with little gain. ledger-s3 keeps a 42-word sentence: Luna's clean split made a 3-sentence list item, which no-new-findings rejects, so Sol only swapped the dash and the tense.
b-fw-role swapped paired dashes for commas and turned an appositive into a list; parentheses would keep the meaning. addr-a carries the 'Every future ...' fragment from the autofix.
Cleanest page: 3 of 7 rewrites improved, none harmful. The role sentence's new 'with' is loose. derived-d also swapped paired dashes for commas, the b-fw-role pattern, but harmless here.

The role paragraph gained 'includes', which makes its scope list partial. dialect-a has the 'Every future command and flag.' fragment. The Decision-item splits (dialect-d, effects-d, migrate-d) are the best rewrites in the batch.

To meet sentence limits the model merges unrelated sentences with 'and' (blocks 12 and 16), which moves the one-topic problem instead of fixing it. Block 17 turned a guide paragraph into a lead plus 5 bullets with the closing instruction last. Block 7's trailing condition ('use docs_set_title when ...') was never flagged by condition-first. paragraph-length is still open on 4 blocks.

Confirmed held: the 7 blocks with '. lowercase' corruption (b-dv-gov-editor, b-dv-gov-vocab, b-dv-dep-d, b-dv-dep-a, b-dv-ops-d, b-dv-ops-a, b-dv-mirror-a) carry ste.broken-sentence and got no autofix and no rewrite. Their 8 findings remain in findingsAfter for a person to repair.
Confirmed exempt: 0 findings, 0 changes, 1579 words before and after. packages/docs-style/src/profile/exemptions.ts lists the page with heading '*'.

meaning-words should also count relational connectors (since, while, because, although, instead): the worst accepted changes dropped exactly these and passed every guardrail. dash-gloss should use a comma before a noun-phrase gloss ('including ...', 'every ...') and skip a gloss that holds its own colon. Paired dashes should become parentheses, not commas or a single colon. Prefer a period over a one-item sub-bullet.
